arguments.snippet:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. BOIDENT2.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 WS-CAPITAL-PCT PIC 9(3)V99.
01 WS-PROFIT-PCT PIC 9(3)V99.
01 WS-CONTROL-IND PIC X.
01 WS-IS-BO PIC X VALUE SPACE.
01 WS-BO-THRESHOLD PIC 9(3)V99 VALUE 10.00.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
    ACCEPT WS-CAPITAL-PCT
    ACCEPT WS-PROFIT-PCT
    ACCEPT WS-CONTROL-IND
    IF WS-CAPITAL-PCT >= WS-BO-THRESHOLD
       OR WS-PROFIT-PCT > WS-BO-THRESHOLD
       OR WS-CONTROL-IND = ''Y''
       MOVE ''Y'' TO WS-IS-BO
    END-IF
    DISPLAY ''BO: '' WS-IS-BO
    STOP RUN.
